description: Word Ladder — transform one word into another changing a single letter at a time, with dictionary validation and shortest-path hints.

faqs.a: Every step must be a real English word (checked against a 2,900-word dictionary), must be the same length as the start word, and must differ from the previous word by exactly one letter.
faqs.q: What counts as a valid step?

faqs.a: Yes — press “Hint” and the built-in solver shows you the next word on the shortest possible path, computed by breadth-first search over the dictionary.
Not every pair of words is connected through single-letter changes. “New puzzle” only deals puzzles the solver has verified as solvable.

howto: Press “New puzzle” to get a start word and a target word.
Type a word that differs by exactly one letter and press “Add step”.
Every step is checked against the dictionary.
Reach the target in as few steps as you can — Hint shows the optimal next move.
title: Word Ladder
